description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeySession's closeKeySession method, specifically testing various scenarios of closing a media key session, including success cases and failure modes, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeySessionCloseKeySessionTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing the closeKeySession method of MediaKeySession, inheriting from MediaKeySessionTestBase.

methods.name: ~RialtoServerMediaKeySessionCloseKeySessionTest
methods.description: Destructor that calls destroyKeySession to clean up after tests.

methods.name: SuccessNetflix
methods.description: Test that closeKeySession succeeds for Netflix key system with all internal calls returning OK.

methods.name: SuccessNoneNetflix
methods.description: Test that closeKeySession succeeds for non-Netflix key systems with close and destructSession calls returning OK.

methods.name: OcdmSessionCancelChallengeDataFailure
methods.description: Test that closeKeySession still succeeds if cancelChallengeData fails with INVALID_STATE.

methods.name: OcdmSessionCleanDecryptContextFailure
methods.description: Test that closeKeySession still succeeds if cleanDecryptContext fails with NOT_SUPPORTED.

methods.name: OcdmCloseFailure
methods.description: Test that closeKeySession fails with NOT_SUPPORTED if the close call on ocdm session fails.

methods.name: OcdmDestructSessionFailure
methods.description: Test that closeKeySession fails with INVALID_STATE if destructSession fails.

methods.name: OnErrorFailure
methods.description: Test that closeKeySession fails with FAIL if onError is called during the operation.
